summary: Direction for ch14, The Unfinished Map: Terra turns an incomplete shared proof into her first deliberately unfinished field record. Source-supported design only; ch13 runtime acceptance and ch14 implementation remain unverified.
keep: The earned reciprocal crossing changes how Terra investigates; W-7744's account remains his own.
The repaired hull retains its scar, giving the chapter a physical subject already present in the game.
Completion requires the player to use the record they assembled.

direction.title: The Unfinished Map
direction.dramaticQuestion: Can Terra make a useful account of a place without pretending that the account finishes it?

entryState.boundary: After actual ch13 completion and immediate handback, on foot at Origin. Never infer completion from chapter selection, elapsed time or W-7744's presence.
earnedFacts: Terra crossed using the end W-7744 held and then maintained the separate reference for his independently completed test.
The chosen survey geometry and repeatability persist.
W-7744's local record remains LOCAL RECORD: PASSAGE OBSERVED. MODEL INCOMPLETE.
The Tidegarden hearth remains restored; existing construction, inventory, repairs and terrain persist.
entryState.opening: Once ch13 guidance retires, offer a quiet optional action at the retained survey: Begin a field record. Terra owns the decision: 'i want to know what else a record leaves out.' The invitation can remain pending.

primaryGameplayIdea.name: Pair observations without merging their claims
primaryGameplayIdea.experience: The player builds a two-place field record by physically visiting the completed survey and the existing repaired-hull scar. Each entry separates what was observed from what remains unanswered. The completed record becomes a small, usable index of those visited places.
primaryGameplayIdea.boundedImplementation: Use existing embodied movement, physical reach, explicit interaction, story persistence, objective markers and a chapter-local record panel. Add authored content and bounded chapter state within owned paths. No freehand map, terrain analysis, new sensing, new renderer or procedural inference is required.
primaryGameplayIdea.meaningfulChoice: At the hull, the player chooses which supported question heads their record: 'what survived the repair?' or 'what did the repair change?' Both preserve the observed scar and repaired condition. The selection persists as the record's heading and determines which entry is initially expanded; neither grants superior evidence.

playerActions.action: At the retained common passage, explicitly begin the record. Inspect a compact entry containing Terra's earned crossing and the attributed local test result.
playerActions.result: The record contains only the route actually completed, including its retained limits. It neither copies W-7744's interiority nor extends his proof to other ground.

playerActions.action: Walk to the existing repaired hull and reach its scar. Press the chapter's observation action while physically present.
playerActions.result: Add the present observation: the repair works and the scar remains. Earlier optional scar observations may be displayed if earned, but no missed repair stage is required or retrospectively awarded.

playerActions.action: Choose the question that will head the field record, then explicitly retain both entries.
playerActions.result: The two places remain separate, attributed observations. Terra says, 'i can keep the question with the thing.' No explanatory answer appears.

playerActions.action: Select the survey entry in the record and choose Return to this place. Close the panel and physically walk back using the existing objective marker.
playerActions.result: On actual arrival, press F to add the return visit. This final use commits chapter completion: the record has helped Terra return to something she has not finished understanding.

direction.signatureMoment: At the repaired hull, the player retains the scar alongside the functioning repair, then selects the earlier survey entry. The same record that could have been a verdict becomes a way back. The player closes it and walks; the final proof of its usefulness is arriving at the place it remembers.

recovery.pause: Pause and focus loss stop progression. Visible Resume restores the current objective without creating observations.
recovery.continue: Continue restores the earned entries, chosen question and pending destination. Revalidate actor, world and physical reach before the next observation or return receipt.
recovery.interruptedTravel: Leaving the route or world preserves all entries. Guidance resumes toward the real destination when applicable; no timeout completes travel.
recovery.existingSaves: Previously recorded scar stages never produce a dead mandatory prompt. The ch14 present-visit receipt is distinct from the optional three-stage accomplishment.
recovery.changedTerrain: Resolve existing anchors against current world state. Do not rebuild pristine terrain or move the player through obstructions. An unreachable required anchor is a feasibility defect to fix within scope.
recovery.panel: Closing the record retains committed entries and returns movement and look immediately. An uncommitted heading choice can be reopened.

direction.cameraHandback: Keep the player-owned embodied view during travel and observations. The record panel releases pointer capture only while open; closing it restores the established gameplay input flow without changing position or view direction. Completion clears mandatory guidance immediately. Cinema owns framing and presentation; Score owns musical treatment. Neither presentation completion nor audio is a progression predicate.

exitState.physical: Terra stands at the retained Origin survey after a real return journey. Free movement and optional ch13 repeat remain available.
exitState.durableChange: A reviewable two-place field record retains source attribution, the chosen unanswered question and an actual return-visit receipt. Its visited-place navigation remains usable after completion.
exitState.characterChange: Terra now makes records that invite further investigation instead of treating successful action as a final explanation.
exitState.limits: W-7744 remains a bounded local tester. The chapter does not move him, recruit him, require a new reply or alter his accepted record.

permittedRevelations: Terra can deliberately preserve an unanswered question beside an observation.
The functioning repaired hull still bears its existing scar.
A personally assembled record can support return without claiming comprehensive knowledge.
openPromises: W-7744's larger allegiance, later recurrence, greater-threat recognition and independent awakening.
Worker 9's eventual identification and the emergent third consciousness; no new attributed voice, memory or motif.
First interstellar warp and A5 Light.
The constellation index, seeded worlds, Makers, authorship and Paradox Lens.
Common Ground runtime acceptance, which remains separate from its signed narrative authority.
direction.builderHandoff: Author the complete four-beat path, registry and journey projections, and main/chapter-ch14-controls.json. Manual control steps must earn both visits, select and retain a heading, select the return entry, walk back and commit the final visit. Continue and recovery must resume before an unearned action and then perform that action visibly. Bind real snapshot pointers and visible selectors after implementation; use adapter observation and ordinary browser controls without storage injection. Runtime, media and independent acceptance remain subsequent gates.

anchorEvents.event: Explicit interaction at the completed survey creates Terra's field record after ch13 handback.
Actual physical attendance at the existing repaired-hull scar adds the present observation.
The player commits a heading and retains both distinct entries with the unanswered question visible.
The player selects the survey entry as a destination and receives ordinary navigation guidance.
Actual arrival and explicit interaction add the return visit and commit completion exactly once.
Mandatory guidance retires immediately; the record and optional survey remain usable.
